## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add switch
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Switch.gx` | `ui/switch/Switch.gx` |
| `Switch.fixtures.go` | `ui/switch/Switch.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/switch/Switch.gx"
package switches

props {
  Name    string   = ""
  Label   string   = ""
  Value   string   = "on"
  Checked bool     = false
  Class   string   = ""
  Attrs   gx.Attrs = nil
}

<label class={gx.Cx("inline-flex h-5 w-9 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full border border-transparent bg-input transition-colors has-[:checked]:bg-primary", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>
  <input type="checkbox" role="switch" name={p.Name} aria-label={p.Label} value={p.Value} checked={p.Checked} class="peer sr-only" />
  <span class="pointer-events-none block size-4 translate-x-0.5 rounded-full bg-background shadow-lg transition-transform peer-checked:translate-x-4"></span>
</label>
```

```go title="ui/switch/Switch.fixtures.go"
package switches

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var SwitchFixtures = gx.Fixtures[SwitchProps]{
	"Off":      {Name: "wifi", Label: "Wifi"},
	"On":       {Name: "wifi", Label: "Wifi", Checked: true},
	"Disabled": {Name: "wifi", Label: "Wifi", Attrs: gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--input`, `--primary`, `--background`.

## Usage

```gx
<switch.Switch name="wifi" checked={p.Wifi} />
```

## Examples

### Off

<Example item="switch" name="switch-off" label="Switch: Off">

```gx
<switches.Switch name="wifi" label="Wifi" />
```

</Example>

### On

<Example item="switch" name="switch-on" label="Switch: On">

```gx
<switches.Switch name="wifi" label="Wifi" checked />
```

</Example>

### Disabled

<Example item="switch" name="switch-disabled" label="Switch: Disabled">

```gx
<switches.Switch name="wifi" label="Wifi" attrs={gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}} />
```

</Example>

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Use a switch when the change takes effect at once.
- Pair the switch with a visible label.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use a switch inside a form that needs a submit button.
- Do not use a switch for a multi-choice setting.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the switch. |
| Space | Toggles the switch. |
